visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans slowly across a steep, rocky mountain slope that is heavily covered in white frost and thick ice crystals. The atmosphere is extremely foggy and hazy, obscuring any distant mountain peaks, while the lighting is dim and overcast, emphasizing the freezing cold environment. (2) A white and grey camper van is parked next to a stone-gabion wall in a misty, paved parking lot. The ground is made of interlocking grey stones, and a street light with solar panels and traffic signals stands nearby against a featureless grey sky. (3) The lens zooms in on a black off-road motorcycle with bright yellow accents parked in a designated parking space. Every visible part of the bike, from the knobby tires and spokes to the seat, handlebars, and circular mirrors, is coated in a thick, textured layer of white frost. (4) A middle-aged man with glasses, a dark wide-brimmed hat, and a green outdoor jacket appears in a handheld selfie shot. He speaks directly to the camera with a neutral, calm expression while standing in the foggy, high-altitude mountain setting. (5) The camera captures the entrance to a parking lot where a yellow and black barrier arm is in the down position. A digital sign displays the text 'CAR IN' and a numerical counter of '000,' while several white cars wait or pass by in the misty background. (6) Extreme close-up shots of road signs and metal poles reveal intricate, feathery ice structures formed by freezing fog. These crystalline ice patterns are sharp, dense, and horizontally oriented, clearly showing the severity of the sub-zero temperatures in this mountainous region.
